name: Samara Spin
blurb: A maple key that learned to fly on purpose.

name: Harbour Leap
blurb: Leaps the breakwater and lands in the same bay every time.

name: Lofty Kite
blurb: Flies high over the ridge and always looks down on everything.

name: Grand Condor Plume
blurb: The biggest feather the Grand Condor ever dropped, and it still floats.

name: Grey Wolf Whistle
blurb: A whistle the king carried, and the wolves still answer it.

name: Snowpeak Cub
blurb: A pocket mountain lion with a mane as fluffy as the peak’s snow.

name: Firefly Lamplighter
blurb: A big chibi firefly who lights the cave one blink at a time and calls itself a star.

name: Rose Canyon Camel
blurb: A chibi camel resting on the warm canyon sand in its striped blanket, in no hurry at all.

name: Lookout Turret
blurb: A pocket watchtower that keeps the wall honest and the birds good company.

name: Pinkhat Drummer
blurb: A chibi gnome in a pink pointed hat who drums out the beach-bar tune until the sun drops into the sea.

name: Tanoa Buddy
blurb: A chibi kava bowl with a sleepy smile, who keeps the circle company until the sea goes dark.

name: Pink Stripe Egg
blurb: A chibi painted egg in a red bow, grinning and never once cracking under pressure.

name: Branch Meditator
blurb: A little carved wood spirit who meditates in the cedar and hums when the mist rolls in.

name: Swinging Glowtail
blurb: A plump glowworm on a silk thread who swings above the pool and hums to the light.

name: Slowpage Tortoise
blurb: A tortoise in spectacles who guides readers through the scrolls, one dignified step at a time.

name: Grinning Stone Face
blurb: A stone face with a kind smile, snug in the arms of the roots.

name: Beaming Headpicker
blurb: A chibi head picker in a big straw cone hat, grinning proudly at the best tea of the slope.

name: Puddle Dancer
blurb: A chibi flamingo twirling on the wet salt, drawing a pink reflection with every step.

name: Hollowtop Menhir
blurb: A chibi standing stone with a mossy cap and a little dark hollow on top, humming softly at dusk.
